description: Outback Road Warnings is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. This dataset provides information about outback road warnings that are currently active in South Australian Outback regions. It shows temporary closures, restrictions and warnings on outback roads categorised by 5 legends: Open Open with warnings 4WD AWD or HV Closed Additional information can be found here:. Coverage: South Australian Outback regions. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are Road Awareness, Road block, major roads, road, road  closures. It offers 1 resource(s) in JSON. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
